pacers.detail: Identified by the "pacer2027" coupon and excluded from every number above. 2026 is left as recorded and is not re-filtered. A 0 here when you expect pacers means the coupon code in races.ts no longer matches what they are using.

projected_cap.detail: 2026's demand curve scaled by the current 1.27x, crossing 300 on day 137 of 239.

projected_race_day.detail: 2026's 250 scaled by the current 1.27x pace, capped at 300. Held flat past day 141 rather than extrapolated, so this is a floor.

prior_outcome.detail: Hit its 200 cap on day 127; 209 finally raced after a few were taken over cap. Waiting list reached 50 in 14 days, then closed — real demand was at least 250 and was never fully counted.

threshold.detail: 1.5x against 2026's 200 registrations, or 1.2x against its 250+ of known demand. The lower figure is fairer and still conservative — the waiting list was closed while filling.

pace.detail: 102 at day 52 in 2027 against 80 at day 52 in 2026.

percent.detail: 198 places remaining against the 300 budget cap. Internal cap is 350 for no-show headroom; fill rate is deliberately tracked against 300.

registered.detail: Runners only. Day 52 of 239 in the 2027 window. 2 pacers excluded, so 104 people are registered in total.
